evidence.observation: H701 reads 435.6 °C while H702 reads 69.7 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 70.0 °C, an extreme isolated heater-temperature discrepancy.
The discrepancy persists: H701 rises to 442.6 °C while H702 is 70.6 °C and the vessel is 70.6 °C; these readings do not distinguish actual localized overheating from a temperature-measurement fault.
Other heater and column temperatures remain between 63.1 and 71.2 °C, unlike T701.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature verification, heater power/output and setpoint records, and allowable heater-temperature limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor or readout error; composition measurements and target specifications are needed to judge separation. Pressure sensors are not installed.
